response.overview: A young nun’s quiet devotion is shattered when a charismatic priest draws her into a world of forbidden desire. What begins as whispered confessions quickly turns into feverish, explicit encounters—anal, oral, and unapologetic—as other women join the spiral of temptation. Structured as interlocking vignettes, Mela proibita (aka Der verbotene Apfel) delivers classic early-2000s Mario Salieri hardcore: stylish, sinful, and relentlessly horny, with Fabiana Venturi and the cast fully surrendering to raw pleasure once the forbidden apple is bitten.
response.title: Mela proibita
